misses.description: the re-read corrector recovered no PASS: none of the 13 PASS-expected e-invoices that did not pass in round 1; the second reader is the same OCR engine at other settings
the model-backed corrector was not run: no API key is configured on the box
the loop trusts the source text: an agent that writes its own source text can quote it; the append-only rule stops rewriting what was read, not adding a forged page
the returned instruction embeds the gate's reason as written: lower-case after 'not executed.' and sometimes a doubled period; fixing it needs a protocol version because replay re-renders the text
AP-R holds 4 invoice-configuration pairs with no published decision at round 0; the prereg did not specify this handling

hash_list_note: PREREG.sha256 was first written on 2026-10-03 with one line, the prereg's sha256, and no time; that one-line list had sha256 b9698d1c19c9646c6b3c3eb46c4b58bb2d9c9209ce8435edea81f9b6eaf084be, which its first line alone still gives. On 2026-10-05 three lines were appended so the tool could read a time: two comment lines and the line "hashed 2026-10-03T17:43:10Z". The hash line is unchanged. The appended time is the authors' own record (the list's file-system time and the run's report), not a third party's, so it says nothing a reader can check about when the prereg was frozen.
